Q24.purpose: Refunds for 'file corrupted' (P003) and 'not as described' by month, with net revenue impact
Q24.sql:
WITH gross AS (
    SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           sum(CAST(unit_price_usd AS DOUBLE) * CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS gross_revenue_usd
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
    WHERE date >= '2026-08-01' AND date < '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY month
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT date_format(to_date(r.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           sum(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'file corrupted' AND o.product_id = 'P003' THEN CAST(r.amount_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS file_corrupted_p003_usd,
           sum(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'not as described' THEN CAST(r.amount_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS not_as_described_usd,
           sum(CASE WHEN r.reason IN ('file corrupted','not as described') THEN CAST(r.amount_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS targeted_refund_usd
    FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
    JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE r.date >= '2026-08-01' AND r.date < '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT g.month,
       g.gross_revenue_usd,
       r.file_corrupted_p003_usd,
       r.not_as_described_usd,
       r.targeted_refund_usd,
       (g.gross_revenue_usd - r.targeted_refund_usd) AS net_revenue_usd,
       r.targeted_refund_usd / g.gross_revenue_usd AS targeted_refund_share
FROM gross g
JOIN refunds r ON g.month = r.month
ORDER BY g.month
